sources.label: Gryphou
sources.author: Gryphou
patch_list: Adds a setting to hide the shared AI input bar and its floating/Home containers throughout the app.
Adds an independent setting to hide the Centre d’avantages (Rewards Hub) Profile entry.
Adds a setting to remove Explorer from navigation, with safe selection and fragment restoration.
Adds a setting to hide the Home header Plus badge while keeping the separate add (+) button.
Adds a setting to remove the Home Recommended card group, including its header and spacing.
Adds an independent setting to hide the Intelligence Recommended page.
Adds a setting to hide only the Tuya AI Web Version entry in Profile.

sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Darkens device control panels that have no dark mode of their own while the phone is in dark mode, using Android's automatic dark theme. It stays off until its switch in Settings is turned on.
Draws the cards on the Home tab as glass in the app's own colors, and gives the weather card a glass edge over its weather background.
Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill, in the app's own colors. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs.
Makes "Sign in with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Removes the Google ad banners and ad rows the app shows, such as the one above the Me menu.
Removes the "How can I help?" Tuya AI bar above the navigation bar and at the bottom of device panels.
Removes the Explore tab from the navigation bar.
Removes the "My Orders" row from the Me tab.
Removes the "Plus" pill from the home header.
Removes the "Recommended for You" section and its cards (AI Notes and the rest) from the home screen.
Removes the "Rewards Hub" row and its banner from the Me tab.
Removes the "Tuya AI Web Version" row from the Me tab.
Lets the patched app start. A patched app is signed with a different key, which the app's integrity check rejects, so without this it closes a few seconds after it opens.
Swipe sideways to go to the next or previous tab of the navigation bar. Where Scene shows Automation and Tap-to-Run as tabs, it switches between them first.

sources.label: SmartLife (com.tuya.smartlife) 向けの Morphe パッチ
sources.author: SmartLife
patch_list: Disables Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics and automatic page tracking, and stops the app's analytics, log-upload and attribution subsystems from starting.

Disables in-app ads (including the AdMob native ad on the home screen), promotional banners, ad push, and ad-related attribution. Stops the corresponding advertising subsystems and removes Home/Profile ad entries.

Hides the "Hey Tuya" AI assistant added in app 7.0 (the AI bar on the home and smart tabs, the device-panel floating ball, the launcher shortcut and the other entry points). This is a runtime toggle: it can be turned on and off in the in-a…
Hides the "おすすめ" (Recommended) cards on the home screen. This is a runtime toggle in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen. Hidden by default.
Hides the recommended scenes ("お勧め") shown under the automation and tap-to-run lists of the smart tab. This is a runtime toggle in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen. Hidden by default.
Hides the "Smart App" tab (AI app builder) at the top of the smart tab. This is a runtime toggle in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen. Hidden by default.
Adds two ways to open the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen: long-press the settings button at the top of the profile tab, or long-press the toolbar of the app's Settings screen.

Keeps the original APK signature visible to the app after re-signing, so the app's integrity self-check passes instead of showing "integrity check failed" and quitting, and so email/phone + password login keeps working. Enabled by default…
